updates.title: Trump holds Iran strikes until after the midterms as oil nears $110 and Houthis hit Saudi Arabia

updates.title: Trump says no Iran strikes before the midterms as fuel prices become a campaign issue

updates.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu as Iran dares the US to strike again and Qatar plans a defense pact
updates.summary: Trump tied his endorsement to the Iran war nine days before Israel's vote; Iran warns of "unfinished jobs" and oil stays near $98.

updates.title: US and Israel weigh renewed Iran strikes as Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israel's Oct. 27 vote

updates.title: White House says no Iran attack before the midterms as Iran sets terms for talks

updates.title: Iran hardens terms for talks as Trump endorses Netanyahu six days before Israel's election
updates.summary: The White House says no attack before Nov. 3, Iran says no uranium leaves, and Brent crude sits near $109.

updates.title: Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu splits Republicans as Iran restates its red lines
updates.summary: Trump endorsed Netanyahu nine days before Israel's Oct. 27 vote, Vance declined to, and Iran says no enriched uranium will leave.

updates.title: Iran sets red lines as the US says it will not strike before the midterms
updates.summary: Iran says 'not a single gram' of enriched uranium leaves. The White House says the blockade stays and no attack comes before Nov. 3.

updates.title: US and Israel reportedly plan new Iran strikes after the midterms as Hormuz tankers burn
updates.summary: Reports of post-election strike plans pushed Brent to $113 as Iran says seven tankers were hit in the strait.

updates.title: U.S. and Israel reportedly plan new Iran strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Oil jumped on a New York Times report of 'short but intensive' strike plans; Trump says the U.S. is not negotiating.

updates.title: Brent hits its highest settlement since April as U.S. and Israel reportedly plan post-midterm Iran strikes
updates.summary: Brent settled at $116.72 as Houthi attacks on Saudi sites and reports of U.S.-Israeli strike plans fed supply fears; Netanyahu urged toppling Iran's regime.

updates.title: Trump says the U.S. could strike Iran again if there is no deal, as reports point to post-midterm plans
updates.summary: At a Florida rally Trump floated 'another little Operation Epic Fury' unless Iran agrees to a deal, while reports say strike plans are being drafted.

updates.title: U.S. pulls diplomats from Saudi Arabia as reports point to Iran strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: The State Department ordered some embassy staff out of Saudi Arabia while U.S. and Israeli planners reportedly prepare new Iran strikes after Nov. 3.

updates.title: U.S. pulls Saudi staff and weighs Iran strikes after the midterms as Brent nears $116
updates.summary: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia push oil higher while reports say the U.S. and Israel are planning Iran strikes after Nov. 3; Trump has not approved them.

updates.title: U.S. has plans for major Iran strikes as Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials visit Tehran

updates.title: U.S. has strike plans ready for Iran as regional powers press Tehran for a deal

updates.title: U.S. has strike plans ready for Iran as regional powers press Tehran for a deal
updates.summary: Two U.S. officials told CNN forces could strike Iran within 96 hours of an order, as Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials met Iranian leaders.

updates.title: U.S. warns Gulf allies to prepare for a short, intense Iran campaign after the midterms, WSJ reports
updates.summary: Trump would not rule out strikes after Nov. 3, saying 'anything's possible,' while talks and the Hormuz blockade continue.

updates.title: Mediators press Tehran for a deal as reports point to major U.S. strikes after Election Day
updates.summary: The U.S. reportedly told Gulf allies to expect a short, intense campaign after Nov. 3, and the IAEA says it cannot verify Iran's nuclear material.

updates.title: Mediators press Tehran as the U.S. readies a week of strikes after the midterms

updates.title: Mediators press Iran on nuclear terms as U.S. plans heavy strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Qatar-led mediators say accepting a package may be Iran's only way to avoid major attacks after Nov. 3.

updates.title: Vance writes to Iran's security chief as U.S. forces prepare for possible strikes after the midterms

updates.title: Treasury says the Iran blockade has crippled its economy as Trump says Tehran wants to talk

updates.title: Qatari mediators hold marathon Tehran talks as Treasury says the Iran blockade is crippling its economy
updates.summary: Axios reports Qatar is pushing a deal before the midterms while Trump keeps the blockade and military options ready.

updates.title: Qatar presses US and Iran toward talks as Washington warns allies of strikes after the midterms
updates.summary: Iran wants the blockade lifted first, the US wants the uranium stockpile, and Trump says he has no hard timetable.

updates.title: Trump says there is no rush to resume Iran strikes as a Qatari draft plan waits for answers
updates.summary: Mediators propose three days of confidence-building steps, and Iran says its two-day Hormuz reopening plan is still unfinished.

updates.title: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island after Iranian fire at a U.S. aircraft while Trump says there is no rush to resume the war
updates.summary: Officials call the strike defensive, and Qatar waits for answers on a three-day confidence-building plan.

updates.title: U.S. strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Vance says no deadline for a deal
updates.summary: Officials call the strike defensive after Iran fired at a U.S. aircraft, while Trump and Vance keep talking about a settlement.

updates.title: A December Fed rate hike remains the base case as inflation stays at 3.7%
updates.summary: NPR and Fox Business report the Fed held rates on Oct. 28, and traders see about a 75% chance of a hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting.

updates.title: Trump says he would 'do it again' on Iran as Qatari mediators wait for answers
updates.summary: Trump says the war was a factor in the losses but necessary, with no rush to resume strikes.

updates.title: IRGC says tankers burned in Hormuz as Trump defends the Iran war
updates.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the strait, one after hitting an Iranian mine.

updates.title: IRGC says tankers burned in Hormuz as Trump weighs deal or force
updates.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard blamed unauthorized routes for fires on two tankers and a tug, while Trump threatens to 'finish the job' without a nuclear deal.

updates.title: Oil rebounds on Hormuz tanker worries as the Iran war becomes Congress's fight
updates.summary: Brent rose 3.8% to $98.29 after a big drop, while Democrats and Republicans argue over funding and accountability for the war.

updates.title: Oil swings on Iran diplomacy and tanker attacks as Democrats vow to end the war
updates.summary: Brent fell about 14% early in the week, then rebounded to $98.29 Thursday, and Eurasia Group put the odds of renewed US strikes at 60%.

updates.title: Trump's approval falls to 30 percent in Pew as the Senate stays a toss-up
updates.summary: Pew puts Trump at 30 percent approval, near his career low, with 23 days left before the Nov. 3 midterms.

updates.title: Republicans shift money to defend red seats as Democrats widen the Senate map
updates.summary: CNN reports a GOP triage mode with three weeks left, while polls show Democrats competitive in Ohio, Kansas, Texas and Alaska.

updates.title: Republicans shift money to defend red seats as Democrats widen the Senate map
updates.summary: CNN reports a GOP triage mode with three weeks left, while polls show Democrats competitive in Ohio, Kansas, Texas and Alaska.

updates.title: Trump's approval sits at 30 percent in Pew as forecasters edge Senate races toward Democrats
updates.summary: Republicans still hold a narrow edge for the Senate, but Fox and Sabato's Crystal Ball both show the map tightening.

updates.title: Senate debates in Maine, Georgia and Iowa and a Trump rally in Alaska headline a big campaign night
updates.summary: Pew puts Trump's approval at 30 percent as Republicans defend seats in several states with the Senate away until November.

updates.title: Senate debates in Georgia, Maine and Iowa turn on Trump, Epstein and the Russia diesel deal
updates.summary: Iowa's Ashley Hinson broke with Trump on the diesel deal, while Georgia's Ossoff and Collins clashed over Epstein files and 2020.

updates.title: Trump's Alaska rally for Sen. Dan Sullivan puts a tight race and falling approval in focus
updates.summary: Trump spoke about 90 minutes in Wasilla, pardoned two diesel mechanics and touted a gas pipeline while a CNN poll of polls has his approval at 33%.

updates.title: Democrats hold a polling edge three weeks out as battleground Republicans create distance from Trump
updates.summary: Polling averages favor Democrats, and Fox News says swing-district Republicans are breaking with Trump on key issues.

updates.title: Republicans scale back battleground spending as polls favor Democrats
updates.summary: National GOP groups are cutting spending in some races, and polls show Democrats ahead by 3 to 9 points depending on the survey.

updates.title: Fox poll puts Trump at a record-low 36% as Democrats lead the generic ballot
updates.summary: Trump's approval hit 36% in a Fox News poll, and Senate control now looks like a coin flip with 18 days to go.

updates.title: Trump rallies in Georgia as Fox News and National Review read the Senate map differently
updates.summary: Trump campaigned for Mike Collins in Dalton, Georgia, while Fox News polling favors Democrats and National Review sees the Senate tightening.

updates.title: Justice Department sues California to block counting of ballots from alleged noncitizens
updates.summary: The DOJ wants a judge to stop California tabulating mail ballots from about 20,000 people it calls likely noncitizens; the state says there is no evidence.

updates.title: California officials vow to fight the Justice Department's suit over ballots for alleged noncitizens
updates.summary: Secretary of State Weber and Attorney General Bonta refuse to withhold ballots for about 20,000 flagged voters, and experts call the suit a long shot.

updates.title: Forecasters favor Democrats for the House and see a toss-up Senate with 16 days to go
updates.summary: Fox, CNN and The Hill all show Democrats ahead in House ratings; Speaker Johnson predicts Republicans will hold on.

updates.title: Trump rallies in Kansas as a deep-red Senate seat becomes competitive
updates.summary: Trump campaigned for Sen. Roger Marshall near Wichita, said the polls are fake, and starts a week of travel to Senate battlegrounds.

updates.title: Trump rallies for Sen. Marshall in Kansas as Republicans defend a long-safe seat two weeks before Election Day
updates.summary: Trump held a Kansas rally for Sen. Roger Marshall, whose race against Democrat Adam Hamilton is rated competitive.

updates.title: Cook shifts three Senate races as Trump's approval hits a record low in one poll
updates.summary: Cook moved South Carolina and Mississippi toward Democrats and Minnesota toward Republicans, while Trump campaigns in red states with two weeks to go.

updates.title: Trump's approval hits a record low in Reuters/Ipsos as Kansas holds its final Senate debate tonight
updates.summary: Reuters/Ipsos has Trump at 31%, Cook shifted three Senate races, and Marshall and Hamilton debate tonight in a toss-up Kansas race.

updates.title: Trump uses the word 'Shylock' at a Kansas rally while defending Sen. Marshall's medical-debt lawsuits
updates.summary: CNN, The Hill and the Washington Examiner report the remark, and CNN's fact check finds no law required Marshall to sue patients.

updates.title: Marshall and Hamilton clash in a fiery final debate as the Kansas Senate race tightens
updates.summary: Both candidates tried to distance themselves from their national parties, while Marshall's medical-debt past and Hamilton's church-camp response drew questions.

updates.title: Two weeks out, polls favor Democrats nationally while the Senate stays contested
updates.summary: Fox's poll has Trump at a record-low 36 percent and Democrats up nine on the House ballot, while analysts see a tight Senate.

updates.title: Polls show Democrats ahead for the Nov. 3 midterms
updates.summary: Fox, CNN and NPR polls all put Democrats ahead on the House ballot and Trump's approval near record lows.

updates.title: Polls show Democrats ahead for the Nov. 3 midterms
updates.summary: Fox, CNN and NPR polls all put Democrats ahead on the House ballot and Trump's approval near record lows.

updates.title: Early voting passes 20 million ballots as both parties argue over what it means
updates.summary: Democrats lead early returns in most states with data, but analysts and Republicans say Election Day turnout will decide it.

updates.title: Early voting runs far ahead of 2022 as Democrats lead where party data exists
updates.summary: Totals differ by tracker, but turnout is up sharply in Texas, Kansas and North Carolina with nine days to go.

updates.title: Early voting runs far ahead of 2022 and Democrats look competitive in Texas, Kansas and Ohio
updates.summary: About 29 million early ballots are in, and Democrats need a net four Senate seats; Fox News has Texas tied at 49%.

updates.title: Trump rallies in Michigan and Mississippi as the Texas Senate race stays tied
updates.summary: With eight days to go, Trump is defending a deep-red Mississippi seat while a Fox News poll has Texas tied at 49% and Michigan near even.

updates.title: Trump heads to Texas as Fox poll has Senate race tied and Michigan stays a toss-up
updates.summary: A Fox News poll has Paxton and Talarico tied at 49%, and Trump campaigns in Waco and Lubbock today.

updates.title: Texas Senate race is tied in the last week as Trump rallies and Michigan stays close
updates.summary: Trump rallies in Texas as a Fox poll has Paxton and Talarico tied at 49%, and Michigan polls split.

updates.title: Senate control runs through Texas, Michigan and Ohio, with polls inside the margin of error
updates.summary: Recent polls show Talarico, El-Sayed and Brown narrowly ahead in Texas, Michigan and Ohio, and Trump is back in Ohio.

updates.title: Democrats lead the generic ballot by about 9 points as Trump and Obama make closing pitches
updates.summary: Polls favor Democrats for the House and keep the Senate close, while Trump rallies in Texas and Ohio and Obama campaigns in Ohio and Michigan.

updates.title: Democrats hold a steady lead in the final week as Trump campaigns in red states
updates.summary: CNN's average has Democrats up about 9 points on the generic ballot; Trump campaigned in Texas, where a Fox poll shows a tie.

updates.title: Democrats lead national polls and Senate odds improve as the midterms near
updates.summary: A Marist poll shows Democrats up 8 points nationally, and new CNN polls show them competitive in Michigan, Texas, Maine and Kansas.

updates.title: Democrats look strong for the House and competitive for the Senate five days before the midterms
updates.summary: New CNN polls show Democrats ahead in Michigan and Texas, and forecasters give them about an 80% shot at the House.

updates.title: Trump reverses his rally cancellations as Democrats lead several Senate polls four days before the midterms
updates.summary: Trump will hold in-person rallies in Iowa and Kansas on Sunday after canceling them, while CNN polls show Democrats ahead in Michigan, Texas and Kansas.

updates.title: Alaska Senate race is roiled by a report that Democratic operatives backed a second Dan Sullivan
updates.summary: A New York Times report alleges Peltola campaign and DSCC staff helped field a second candidate named Dan Sullivan, which both deny.

updates.title: Trump revives Iowa and Kansas rallies as CNN polls show Democrats ahead in Michigan and Texas
updates.summary: After canceling and then restoring two red-state rallies, Trump will appear in Dubuque and Salina on Sunday while Senate polling tightens.

updates.title: Trump closes the midterm campaign in Iowa and Kansas as control of Congress hangs on toss-up Senate races
updates.summary: Trump holds rallies in Dubuque and Salina on Sunday after cancelling and then reinstating them, with two days to go.

updates.title: Voters decide control of Congress on Tuesday, with Democrats favored in the House and the Senate a toss-up
updates.summary: Forecasters give Democrats a strong edge in the House, while the Senate hinges on Alaska, Iowa, Maine, South Carolina, Texas and Michigan.

updates.title: Voters decide control of Congress as polls open, with Democrats favored in the House and the Senate in play
updates.summary: Democrats need three House seats and lead CNN's generic-ballot average by 9 points, while Fox rates the Senate a toss-up.

updates.title: Judge tosses Justice Department Alaska ballot suit as Trump hedges on accepting results and DOJ sends record monitors
updates.summary: The department will appeal the Alaska ruling to the 9th Circuit, and about 1,000 monitors are deployed in all 50 states.

updates.title: Polls close across the country with control of Congress undecided
updates.summary: Control of the House and Senate is at stake tonight, and NPR warns the Senate call could take much longer than the House.

updates.title: House Democrats weigh investigations first and impeachment later
updates.summary: Jeffries has not ruled impeachment in or out, and reporters say probes of Trump's businesses and immigration enforcement come first.

updates.title: Vance says the Iran war cost Republicans the midterms, and Trump calls that largely true
updates.summary: Vice President Vance blamed the Iran war for the GOP rout, and Trump said it was largely true but that he would do it again.

updates.title: Vance says the Iran war cost Republicans the midterms, and Trump partly agrees
updates.summary: Vice President Vance blamed the Iran war for the GOP rout, while Trump said Iran was part of it but defended the war.

updates.title: Democrats hold 54 Senate seats in NBC's count as Mississippi hangs on a few dozen votes
updates.summary: Democrats swept Congress, but the Mississippi Senate race is separated by dozens of votes and the state has no recount process.

updates.title: Conservative writers blame Trump, the Iran war and affordability for the Republican rout
updates.summary: National Review, the Free Press and the Washington Examiner give competing explanations for the GOP's midterm losses.

updates.title: Democrats plan oversight blitz and Trump promises vetoes
updates.summary: Incoming committee chairs target Trump family business, immigration enforcement and the Iran war, while Trump says he will become 'Mr. Veto'.

updates.title: Mississippi Senate race stays too close to call with mail ballots due Tuesday and no recount process
updates.summary: Democrat Scott Colom leads Sen. Hyde-Smith by about 1,800 votes while both parties prepare for a fight over provisional ballots.

updates.title: Democrats win both chambers and set an agenda of health care, tariffs and ending the Iran war
updates.summary: NBC projects about 255 House seats for Democrats, and Jeffries names four priorities while Trump promises vetoes.

updates.title: Vance blames the Iran war for the Republican rout, while Toomey, Cruz and conservative writers cite tariffs
updates.summary: Trump partly agrees with Vance's war diagnosis, and right-leaning outlets split over tariffs, the war and Trump's treatment of Congress.

updates.title: Mississippi's Senate race stays too close to call as provisional and late mail ballots are counted
updates.summary: Democrat Scott Colom leads Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith by roughly 2,500 votes in CNN's count, with provisional ballots and lawyers on both sides.

updates.summary: Backers of Props. 40 to 42 face a lopsided money gap even as PPIC polling shows Prop. 40 narrowly ahead.

updates.summary: Prop. 40 leads narrowly in polls, and Newsom has endorsed a rival measure that would nullify it and bar future wealth taxes.

updates.summary: Prop. 40 polls 52% to 46% in PPIC, while Prop. 42, backed by Newsom and Sergey Brin, would void it and ban wealth taxes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax is a close call, and Newsom backs a measure to cancel it
updates.summary: Prop. 40 polls near 50%, and Prop. 42 would void it if it gets more votes.

updates.title: Newsom endorses Prop. 42, a ban on wealth taxes that would cancel the billionaire tax
updates.summary: Newsom opposes Prop. 40 and backs Prop. 42, splitting from the state Democratic Party and labor groups that endorse the billionaire tax.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax holds a slim poll lead, but two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: A September PPIC poll had Prop. 40 at 52 percent to 46 percent, and Newsom backs Prop. 42, which would ban new wealth taxes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax holds a slim poll lead, but two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: Prop. 40 leads narrowly, while Props. 41 and 42, backed by tech billionaires, could void it if either gets more yes votes.

updates.title: California's billionaire tax is a close call, and two rival measures could cancel it

updates.title: California's billionaire tax is a close call, and two rival measures could cancel it
updates.summary: Prop 40 polls from slightly ahead to slightly behind, and Props 41 and 42 could block it even if it passes.

updates.title: New PPIC poll puts California's billionaire tax behind, 46% to 52%
